description: Perform syntax check on an ABAP function group. Returns syntax errors, warnings, and messages.

version.description: Which version to check — it goes into the checkrun body as chkrun:version, as ADT sends it. Omitted, the inactive one is checked; an object that is only active has none, and SAP answers such a check with a finding against an empty source (e.g. G46 "REPORT/PROGRAM statement is missing") or "Inactive version … does not exist" — ask for active.

name: CheckFunctionGroup
